definitions.explanation: The Japanese imperial era name for the reign of Emperor {昭和|しょうわ} (Hirohito), spanning 1926 to 1989. Years are counted from the start, so {昭和|しょうわ}{50年|ねん} is 1975.

examples.japanese: {昭和|しょうわ}{生|う}まれです。
examples.english: I was born in the Showa era.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{昭和|しょうわ}の{時代|じだい}を{生|い}きた。
examples.english: My grandfather lived through the Showa era.

examples.japanese: この{町並|まちな}みには、{今|いま}でも{昭和|しょうわ}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}が{色濃|いろこ}く{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: This townscape still retains a strong Showa-era atmosphere even today.

notes:
The {元号|げんごう} (Japanese era name) for 1926–1989, the reign of Emperor {昭和|しょうわ}. Years within the era are counted from one, so {昭和|しょうわ}{元年|がんねん} is 1926.

FIGURATIVE USE:
Colloquially, {昭和|しょうわ} describes things that feel old-fashioned or nostalgically retro:
- {昭和|しょうわ}っぽい: has a retro, old-school feel
- {昭和|しょうわ}の{香|かお}り: a nostalgic, bygone atmosphere

RELATED ERAS:
- {明治|めいじ}: Meiji (1868–1912)
- {平成|へいせい}: Heisei (1989–2019)
- {令和|れいわ}: Reiwa (2019–present)
